ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) base surface with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters forming an approximate 95:5 dark-to-light ratio across the fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous dark grey field. High-contrast white annular rings (approximately 15-25 pixels in diameter) are distributed across both lobes. High-intensity, high-texture clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 70-80 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total vertical extent of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary displays low-amplitude micro-serrations in the medial sections, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys at the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer boundaries exhibit a symmetrical concave upward sweep from the peduncle, with the trailing edge following an irregular convex arc toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular white high-contrast rings (scars) are visible: approximately 10 discrete units on the left lobe and 12 on the right lobe, concentrated in the central and upper-medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-width linear white pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, specifically a diagonal mark roughly 1/3 in from the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of irregular, high-texture calcified-looking material at both distal tips, creating a 'fringed' or heavily eroded appearance on the lateral boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips of the fluke exhibit a unique bulbous, heavily textured morphology distinct from the smoother trailing edge sections.
